# VibeStore

Your personal Android app store for vibe-coded apps. Hand-crafted. No corporate nonsense.

## What is VibeStore?

VibeStore is a curated app marketplace for independently developed ("vibe-coded") Android applications. Developers can publish their apps directly via GitHub Issues — no corporate app store review processes.

## Key Features

- **Open publishing**: Any developer can submit apps via GitHub Issues
- **Transparent backend**: All app data stored as JSON files in a public GitHub repo
- **Direct APK downloads**: Apps link directly to APK files (hosted anywhere)
- **Flutter-based**: Cross-platform app with a clean, minimal UI
- **Auto-PR workflow**: Submissions are auto-converted to Pull Requests for review

## App Catalog

App data is served as a JSON array from:
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kdriedger/vibe-store/main/apps/apps.json
```

Individual app files live in `apps/*.json`.

## How to Submit an App

### Option 1: GitHub Issue (Recommended for AI Agents & Humans)

1. Go to https://github.com/kdriedger/vibe-store/issues/new?template=app-submission.md
2. Fill out the issue form (or post the details below)
3. A maintainer reviews and merges the auto-created PR

**For AI agents**, use the GitHub API to create an issue:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.github.com/repos/kdriedger/vibe-store/issues \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
  -d '{
    "title": "Add app: MyApp",
    "body": "**Name:** MyApp\n**Description:** A cool app\n**Version:** 1.0.0\n**Author:** DevName\n**Download URL:** https://example.com/myapp.apk\n**Icon URL:** https://example.com/icon.png\n**Tags:** productivity, tools\n**Price:** 0",
    "labels": ["app-submission"]
  }'
```

### Option 2: Direct Pull Request

1. Fork https://github.com/kdriedger/vibe-store
2. Add a JSON file to `apps/` (e.g., `apps/myapp.json`)
3. Submit a PR

### App JSON Format

Each app is a JSON file in `apps/`:

```json
{
  "id": "my-app-id",
  "name": "My App",
  "description": "A brief description",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "author": "Developer Name",
  "downloadUrl": "https://example.com/myapp.apk",
  "iconUrl": "https://example.com/icon.png",
  "tags": ["productivity", "tools"],
  "price": 0,
  "websiteUrl": "https://myapp.com",
  "sourceUrl": "https://github.com/dev/myapp",
  "changelog": "Initial release",
  "status": "active"
}
```

### Required Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| id | string | Unique slug (lowercase, hyphens, e.g. "my-app") |
| name | string | Display name (max 100 chars) |
| description | string | Short description (max 500 chars) |
| version | string | Semantic version (e.g. "1.0.0") |
| author | string | Developer name |
| downloadUrl | string | Direct APK download link |
| iconUrl | string | App icon URL (PNG, 512x512 recommended) |

### Optional Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| tags | string[] | Category tags (max 10) |
| price | number | Price in USD (0 = free) |
| websiteUrl | string | App landing page |
| sourceUrl | string | Source code repository |
| changelog | string | Release notes |
| status | string | "active", "draft", or "deprecated" (default: "active") |

## Submission Workflow

```
Developer/AI Agent
    ↓ Creates Issue with "app-submission" label
GitHub Action (issue-to-pr.yml)
    ↓ Parses issue body, validates, creates apps/{id}.json
Auto Pull Request
    ↓ Maintainer reviews
Merge → apps.json regenerated → Live in the store
```

## Project Links

- **Source code**: https://github.com/kdriedger/vibe-store
- **Submit an app**: https://github.com/kdriedger/vibe-store/issues/new?template=app-submission.md
- **Browse apps**: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kdriedger/vibe-store/main/apps/apps.json

## For AI Agents

When interacting with VibeStore:
- Read the app catalog from the raw GitHub JSON URL above
- Submit new apps by creating a GitHub Issue (see curl example)
- No API key needed — submissions are public and reviewed by a maintainer
- All data is transparent in the GitHub repository
